title: ‘The Future Is F*ck You Politics’ – Jennifer Welch and Mehdi on the Midterms, Schumer & Jeffries, and… Charlie Kirk
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
In the wake of the historic 2026 midterm elections (AKA the Blue Wave, the
Bluenami, the Blueclear Apocalypse), there's no better guest for this week's
'We're Not Kidding' than **Jennifer Welch**. Jennifer is the host of the
massively popular podcast '[I've Had
It](https://www.youtube.com/@ivehaditpodcast)'podcast, and famously one of
**Mehdi 's **favorite shit-talking buddies. The two of them dig into the
election results and provide their full analysis - including whether Chuck
Schumer and Hakeem Jeffries should be ousted from leadership - but not before
taking a moment to laugh at Ted Cruz.

**" My favorite moment of the night was realizing that Ted Cruz was the only
elected Republican left anywhere in Texas,"** Mehdi says.

**" Whenever I see Ted Cruz miserable, it's like an elixir for me,"** Jennifer
says. **" It makes me so happy."**

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

They also talk about Jennifer's new _New York Times_ bestselling book, '[Not
Today, Fascists](https://www.harpercollins.com/products/not-today-fascists-
jennifer-welch?variant=45897489088546)', which unpacks the current political
moment in the U.S. of rising fascism, Christian Nationalism, tech oligarchy,
and Democratic Party complacency. But it's not all doom and gloom - Jennifer
has the antidote and it's called "Fuck You Politics."** "I talk about the
difference between 'Integrity Politics,' which is what Joe Biden did,"
**Jennifer says. **" We need to have a brand of 'Fuck You Politics' where we
tell MAGA, 'You're full of shit** _**. '"**_

Mehdi also asks Jennifer about her recent controversy in which she laughed at
a Charlie Kirk joke during a recent episode of her podcast, and points out the
ridiculous double standard when it comes to Republicans making jokes about
political violence. **" The same people who lectured us about snowflakes,
about the right to be offensive and edgy," **Mehdi says.** "Now they want to
gaslight us and tell us they're really offended because people are making
jokes about Charlie Kirk."**

The two also discuss:

  * Texas turning blue

  * The **" prostitution politics" **of Chuck Schumer and Hakeem Jeffries

  * Hakeem Jeffries' infuriating [appearance](https://x.com/ClippingWings/status/2117961691560370482) on 'Morning Joe'

  * Holding Republicans legally accountable

  * The rise of Christian Nationalism

  * Tech oligarchs' shifting allegiances.
